persistence: None. Typed Rust contract description, not a JSON record/schema reader. All new inputs/requests/results/sets/views have no Serde/default or persisted authority admission.

request.original_plan: Original mutation full intent/context/target/request/allowances and exact operation sequence
request.wire: Exact independent observation target/method/digest checked against separately supplied declared observer digest; status/mutations reject
request.observation_digest: Supplied by exact retained intent/reservation owner. Model compares bytes only; does not inspect journals or prove retention, spend or dispatch. Original mutation request stays unchanged.

max_remote_observations.meaning: Descriptive invocation ceiling; never a reservation, remaining allowance or spending authority

visibility.Public: Allows reading without controller projection, never mutation control
visibility.AllowedViewers: Known normalized sorted unique 0..10 viewer principals; caller viewer or controller may read
visibility.unknown: No variant/default; provider fails before admission

observation.controllers: Optional complete known ControllerSet (0..10); None is unobserved, Some(empty) known empty. None cannot establish controller path but independent public/explicit caller-viewer evidence can establish read access.
observation.evidence: Opaque qualified evidence digest, not signature/dispatch authority
observation.remote_observations: Actual calls requiring separate prior approved per-call accounting

admission: Known exact caller-controller path first, else Public, else exact caller in AllowedViewers; otherwise fail

provider_errors.Unavailable: No qualified provider; no remote effects
provider_errors.Unsupported: Cannot satisfy contract; no remote effects
provider_errors.Indeterminate: Uncertain reply/observation/accounting; retain consumed allowance/evidence, stop without retry

encoding: 64 canonical lowercase ASCII original intent bytes
64 canonical lowercase ASCII independent exact list wire-digest bytes

excluded_authority: Snapshot metadata/data request or response codecs/transfer completeness
Effect settlement/lifecycle/application consistency/fence/restore safety/terminal reference release
integration_obligations: Qualify authenticated actual snapshot visibility/context/target/viewers and complete controllers when used
Own fresh unique challenges, timing and coherent custody; echoed labels/old receipts/unqualified queries are insufficient
Retain exact observer intent/reservation and account each paid call before dispatch; ceilings cannot replenish journals
A permission observation does not perform the requested list or settle a lost list reply; retain pending uncertainty without retry
Fail unknown visibility; never substitute status/log visibility or Root-configured flags
qualified_scope: Native local binding/permission policy and spent-journal recovery only; no installed provider/backend or full B1/B2 completion.
